scientific_limitations: Exact ensemble terminal-phase fractions over a rate set with a finite accumulation point are required to recover the splitting profile; any finite set is insufficient. Recovering a drift additionally requires fixed known diffusivity and a regular one-dimensional return diffusion. No duration or negative-side return law, statistical stability, experimental validation, or independent audit is inferred.
title: Phase-of-capture tomography and a universal majority crossover for Brownian search with stochastic home returns
